title: P3 tools/call: request
description: A tool call by the runtime through P3 by the MCP profile without sessions (spec/bindings/mcp/README.md). The tool name comes from the tools/list of this handle; the arguments are checked by the closed schema of the manifest or of the built-in tool (INJ-1), so here they are only an object. The trace context in _meta does not affect decisions; the handle is not in the body, it is in the header and does not get into model context (SEC-3).

name.description: Tool name: <plugin>/<tool> or a built-in one from builtin-tools.yaml.

arguments.description: Arguments; the core takes the closed schema from the manifest.
arguments.x-botaru-closed-by: inputSchema of the tool from the P3 catalog of the handle (APR-18)
